description: This source file defines an asynchronous S3 logging integration class 'S3Logger' that handles logging events by batching and uploading them to an S3 bucket. It includes methods for configuration, event logging, batch processing, and S3 object management, including upload and download functionalities, with AWS request signing. The class extends 'CustomBatchLogger' and 'BaseAWSLLM' and integrates with external AWS and HTTP libraries.

classes.description: A logging class that batches log events and uploads them asynchronously to an S3 bucket, supporting configuration for multiple AWS parameters and integrated AWS request signing.
